name: Albania (Democratic Government, 1944–1946)
description: A red field with a black double-headed eagle in the centre and a yellow hammer and sickle in the upper hoist.
history: Flag of the Democratic Government of Albania, the communist-led government that took power at the end of the war of liberation, first published in the War Bulletin of 28 November 1944 with a hammer and sickle beside the eagle. The Constituent Assembly of 10 January 1946 replaced it with the flag bearing a gold-bordered red star above the eagle.
